title: Tinga Lens: Environmental monitoring for Ghana
description:
Tinga Lens turns public satellite, climate, soil and biodiversity records into district-level maps and figures for Ghana's 260 districts: rainfall, soil moisture, vegetation, fires, fire probability, tree cover loss, observed flooding, built-up area, recorded species, cropland, main crops and topsoil properties. This archive is the first public release (v1.0.0) of the website, the data-processing code and the published district results.
